registry.definition: Confirmed upward close swing followed immediately by confirmed downward close swing in same contiguous session AM/PM segment, sharing peak anchor; correction amplitude / upward amplitude, no clipping; fixed 0.5*(priorClose*S) reversal. S from prior 10 authorized sessions, >=5 valid true ranges. Downward leg usable only at upward reversal confirmation. Reset on missing5m/lunch/day. No eligible pair => null. Record each event, per-session mean, event-pair count and event-bearing sessions separately.
